Arishta.note: Daughter of Daksha, wife of Kashyap; mother of the Gandharvas.

Chitraratha.note: King of the Gandharvas (Angaraparna); Arjuna bested him on the Ganga and he gave the Pandavas the Chakshushi lore and celestial horses.

Tumburu.note: A Gandharva master of music, singer in Indra's court.

VishvavasuG.name: Vishvavasu
VishvavasuG.note: A gandharva king. By the apsara Menaka he fathered Pramadvara, who was left as a newborn on the bank of a river and picked up by the rishi Sthulakesha. Not the Vishvavasu of the Bhargavas, Jamadagni's eldest, who is elsewhere in this tree. MBh 1.8

Pramadvara.note: Daughter of the gandharva Vishvavasu and the apsara Menaka, abandoned at birth and raised by Sthulakesha. On the eve of her wedding to Ruru she stepped on a snake in the grass and died of it, and lay there beautiful and dead until a messenger of the devas told Ruru he could have her back for half of his own remaining life. MBh 1.8-9

unions.note: MBh 1.8. Menaka bore her and left her; there was no marriage to record.
